why.title: Why Menuyukti exists
why.subtitle: Restaurants sell in the dining room—not a checkout cart. Instagram still expects a constant stream of posts. Menuyukti’s AI takes the repetitive decisions off your plate so you can stay on food.
why.item1Title: Offline businesses need a different playbook
why.item1Description: Online brands optimize for clicks and carts. Restaurants optimize for foot traffic, tables, and reputation—so generic social playbooks miss how hospitality actually grows.
why.item2Title: Instagram never stops asking for posts
why.item2Description: Today’s feed rewards cadence: what to say, when to post, and which dish to feature—again and again. That cognitive load competes with the kitchen and the floor.
why.item3Description: Menuyukti uses your sales data to choose the right time, topic, and menu item—so Instagram stays full while your team stays focused on food.

foundation.title: Built on a unique foundation
foundation.subtitle: Menuyukti is built on enterprise engineering and proprietary AI—bringing Chat campaigns, sales reports, and location insights together in one workspace.
foundation.item1Description: More than a decade building platforms for banking, industrial companies, and the public sector—enterprise-grade software engineering behind how your marketing runs.
foundation.item2Description: An AI platform built for restaurant marketing: sales analysis, campaign planning in Chat, and growth opportunity discovery grounded in your orders—not generic social tools.
foundation.item3Description: Owners, marketers, and partners work in one workspace—invite your Team, share locations, and keep campaigns and reports aligned across the floor.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.a1: Restaurant owners, operators, and marketers at restaurants, cafés, and bars who want campaigns and reports grounded in their sales data.
faq.q2: How is Menuyukti different from a typical marketing tool?
faq.a2: Menuyukti is restaurant-only software with proprietary AI. Chat, Reports, Locations, and Team live in one workspace—built for hospitality marketing, not generic social posting.
faq.a3: Chat helps plan campaigns from your sales context; Reports surface patterns and opportunities in your orders. You review and decide—AI speeds the work; your judgment shapes the strategy.
faq.q4: What can I do in the app today?
faq.a4: Use Chat for campaign planning, Reports for sales insight, Locations to manage venues, and Team to invite people to your workspace.
faq.a5: Menuyukti is preparing for launch. If you already have platform access, sign in from the header or the buttons on this page.
faq.q6: I already use the Menuyukti platform. Where do I sign in?
faq.a6: Existing platform users can sign in from the header to access Chat, Reports, Locations, and Team.
faq.q7: How does Menuyukti compare on cost?
faq.a7: Menuyukti focuses exclusively on restaurants and runs on a proprietary AI platform built for hospitality marketing. Packages are designed for restaurant economics; pricing details will be shared when onboarding opens for new clients.
faq.a8: The platform is currently available to existing customers and early partners only. A broader public launch is in preparation—check back soon for when sign-up opens more widely.
